product_family: Content operating system for AI search. Single integrated platform handling research, writing, optimization, publishing, and monitoring across Google and AI platforms (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI). Includes Frase Answers, AI Agent, SEO/GEO optimization, Content Guard, and FraseCMS publishing.

certifications.name: ISO 27001

certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Frase does not handle payment card data directly; payment processing delegated to payment providers.

privacy.ai_training_note: Frase explicitly does NOT use Customer Data to develop or train generalized AI/ML models. Terms state: 'Frase does not use Customer Data obtained through Google Workspace APIs or any other platform to develop, improve, or train generalized AI and/or machine learning (ML) models.' Data accessed through integrations is used solely for service delivery. Frase may use aggregated, anonymized, or de-identified data for analytical purposes and industry benchmarks (minimum 10 customers required per benchmark; opt-out available via support@frase.io).
privacy.data_region: Not specified. Company headquarters in Birmingham, AL USA. No data residency options mentioned in public documentation.

security.name: Access Control

security.name: Code Security
security.value: Code reviews and vulnerability scanning integrated into development workflow

security.name: Third-party Audits

products.name: Frase Platform (Full Loop)
products.data_scope: Processes customer content, visitor questions, SERP data, competitor data, AI platform citations, brand voice samples. Does not train on customer data. Uses aggregated anonymized data for benchmarking.
products.notes: Single integrated platform for content teams and agencies. Handles research, AI-assisted writing, optimization, publishing (WordPress, Webflow, Sanity, Wix, FraseCMS), monitoring (Google rankings + AI platform citations), and auto-fix workflows. Free trial: 7 days, no credit card. Paid plans: Starter $39/mo, Professional $103/mo, Scale $239/mo (annual billing with 20% discount). Enterprise available by quote. Autonomous publishing available after earned trust per content type.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (7-day trial), tiered SaaS: Starter $39/mo | Professional $103/mo | Scale $239/mo (annual). Additional seats $29/mo. Enterprise by quote. 20% discount for annual billing.
compare.data_residency: US-based (no options documented). Company based in Birmingham, AL.

flags: Only holds SOC 2 Type II and GDPR - no ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or other enterprise certifications publicly documented. Appropriate for the growth-stage market segment (content teams, agencies), but limited for regulated industries (healthcare, finance).
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) mentioned. GDPR rights offered but DPA availability not documented on public pages.
Data residency not configurable - no mention of EU data centers or regional data storage options in public documentation.
Security language uses 'reasonable, commercially acceptable security procedures' which is standard boilerplate; specific controls details limited to high-level encryption + RBAC.
